query:
SELECT 
  vsr.id,
  vsr.userId,
  vsr.twinId,
  vsr.scenarioId,
  vsr.userResponse,
  u.name as user_name
FROM value_scenario_responses vsr
JOIN users u ON vsr.userId = u.id
ORDER BY vsr.id;
